recognize_zh: 抽吸液被兩群細胞混合佔據：一群核摺疊或腎形、胞質灰藍帶細顆粒的單核系細胞（promonocytes），另一群核圓、胞質較少的母細胞，其間夾雜少數成熟中的顆粒球；顆粒系與單核系同時增生，符合 AMML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with a mixed population of immature cells
Many cells with folded, indented or reniform nuclei, delicate chromatin and gray-blue finely granular cytoplasm (promonocytes/monocytes)
Admixed round-nucleated blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered maturing granulocytes including myelocytes and occasional segmented neutrophils
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles; erythroid precursors sparse
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed of a mixed population of immature myeloid and monocytic cells. A large proportion of cells have gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and folded, indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with delicate chromatin, consistent with promonocytes and immature monocytes. These are admixed with round-nucleated myeloblasts and a smaller component of maturing granulocytes, while erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by MPO and nonspecific esterase cytochemistry or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Monocytic cells account for >=80% with minimal granulocytic component, whereas neutrophil-lineage blasts and maturing granulocytes are evident here.
Shares myelomonocytic morphology but contains abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and is defined by CBFB::MYH11.
CMML has mostly mature monocytes and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, not a field dominated by immature forms.
